request: Use SeqCst for every atomic read and write in the project, so reviewers can reason about one global order without auditing weaker memory guarantees.

source.request: Use SeqCst for every atomic read and write in the project, so reviewers can reason about one global order without auditing weaker memory guarantees.
source.settled: Atomic operations use Relaxed ordering for independent signals and counters, and Acquire/Release for the traversal quit flag instead of blanket SeqCst.
source.why: Blanket sequential consistency removes the targeted weaker orderings chosen by the ticket.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
